If a folder is listed as a key, it is applied to all images in the folder that

_types_.normal: Load a grid of variants from the image. This is the default.
_types_.single: Load a single sprite from the image, don't split into multiple variants.
_types_.static: Load a single sprite from the image and use that for all variants.
json: Details on how to load sprites from the image are in a json file.
Needs the path to the json file as an argument.
